description:
Sets Item Equipped State using the reviewed inventory revision.
Use when: the player explicitly requests this inventory action.
Not for: automatic retries, client grants, changing instance IDs or revisions to force an uncertain action through.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. An exact reviewed inventory revision and instance UUID.
Side effects: Sets this instance's equipped boolean; it does not enforce game-specific slot rules. One HTTP attempt only.
Returns: Complete {userId,revision,instances,limits,serverTime} inventory. Replace only the matching host/project/player cache. Instances carry server-generated UUIDs, properties, equipped and createdAt.
Errors: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or an uncertain response: use horizon_get_items and reconcile intent, never silently substitute a new revision and repeat. 404 ITEM_NOT_FOUND means this instance no longer exists. 422 ITEM_PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED/ITEM_PROPERTY_LIMIT_REACHED rejects the entire adjustment. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

expectedRevision.description: Exact reviewed revision; never refresh and substitute automatically

instanceId.description: Exact owned item instance UUID from the reviewed inventory

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Authorization Bearer

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the session

name: horizon_equip_item
title: Set Item Equipped State
